recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片（cytospin）中出現數顆大型異型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、有切迹或分葉，染色質細緻並可見明顯核仁，細胞質淡藍含小空泡；在已知被套細胞淋巴瘤病人身上，這是母細胞樣/多形性變異型（blastoid/pleomorphic MCL）侵犯中樞神經的表現。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, 2-3 times the size of red cells, in a clean background
Irregular nuclear contours with notches, clefts and lobulation
Finely dispersed to blastoid chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with scattered small clear vacuoles
Cells cluster in small groups; no normal lymphocytes or monocytes for comparison in this field
describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows several large atypical lymphoid cells in a clean background with scattered red cells. The cells have irregular, notched to lobulated nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, distinct nucleoli and a moderate amount of pale blue, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. Mature small lymphocytes and monocytes are not seen in this field. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage; flow cytometry or cyclin D1/SOX11 immunocytochemistry is needed. In the setting of known disease, findings are consistent with CSF involvement by mantle cell lymphoma with blastoid/pleomorphic cytomorphology.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving CSF
ddx.vs: Can look identical; flow or immunostains showing CD5 with cyclin D1/SOX11 and t(11;14) favor MCL.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic or acute myeloid leukemia in CSF
ddx.vs: Blasts are usually more uniform with scanter cytoplasm and express TdT/CD34 or myeloid markers rather than mature B-cell markers with cyclin D1.
Have folded nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm but show condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli and are CD14/CD68 positive.
Forms cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and keratin positivity, lacking CD45.
